description: Packages (bun.lock), action digests and flake.lock (lock file maintenance). Vendored files move with the geist package version or by hand, never by Renovate.

packageRules.description: One pull request for compatible package updates; majors stay separate.
A peer range is what apps must provide: widen it on purpose, not on every release.
Bun comes from the nixpkgs in flake.lock (scripts/ci.sh checks they match): move packageManager with flake.lock, by hand.
